name: ros1-development
tagline_zh: 写ROS1节点总在编译报错、tf漂移、launch文件玄学？这里藏着catkin陷阱和actionlib坑。
tagline_en: Tired of ROS1 build fails, tf drift, and launch file mysteries? Get catkin pitfalls and actionlib gotchas—fix.
desc_en: Best practices, design patterns, and common pitfalls for ROS1 (Robot Operating System 1) development. Use this skill when building ROS1 nodes, packages, launch files, or debugging ROS1 systems. Trigger whenever the user mentions ROS1, catkin, rospy, roscpp, roslaunch, roscore, rostopic, tf, actionlib, message types, services, or any ROS1-era robotics middleware. Also trigger for migrating ROS1 cod
why_zh: 它把ROS1的坑按场景分类，直接给可复用的设计模式，比翻文档快三倍，还附迁移避雷指南。
why_en: It categorizes ROS1 pitfalls by scenario with reusable patterns, saving hours vs docs, plus migration gotchas.
